notes.title: [Beta] Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Helo dear players!
During last months we had been working on major improvements of a game. We were focused on input related stuff. It took some time to put all together - however, here we are! We hope you gonna enjoy those improvements.

What's new:
- analog controls,
- customizable input,
- update of FMOD library.

Update is available on branch [b]open-beta-tests[/b]
